mobile.title: Getting around on mobile
mobile.sub: Three moves are all you need
mobile.s1p: Tap ☰ at the top left, or swipe right, to see every channel.
mobile.s2p: Tap a channel to open it. Swipe right again to go back.
mobile.s3p: Tap the threads icon at the top right of a channel to see its threads.

desktop.title: Getting around on desktop
desktop.sub: The same in the app and at discord.com/app
desktop.l1p: Every server you are in, down the far left.
desktop.l2p: This server's channels. Click one to open it. Threads sit just under their channel.
desktop.l3p: Messages in the channel or thread you have open.
desktop.l4p: Type here and press Enter. The + adds a screenshot.
desktop.l5p: Lists every thread in this channel, including yours.
desktop.l6p: Who is here. Moderators show at the top.

help.title: Your private help thread
help.sub: Only you and the moderators can see it
help.s1p: In help-desk, press Get help on the pinned message.
help.s2p: Tap Open my help thread to jump straight into it.
help.s3p: Type your question. Tap + to add a screenshot.
help.foot: Lost your thread? Open help-desk and tap the threads icon, or press Get help again.

verify.title: Unlock the full server
verify.s1p: Open the server guide and press your exchange's button.
verify.s2p: In the exchange app, open your profile and copy the UID number.
verify.s3p: In any 🔒 channel press Verify my UID, pick your exchange and paste.
verify.foot: Only accounts opened through our links can be verified. A UID is a number, never a password or API key.

map.title: What's where
map.sub: Your language's channels, and what opens when you verify
openItems: Get help in a private thread
map.foot: Until you verify, these show as 🔒 trade-signals and 🔒 trading-group.

scams.title: Spot a scam
neverItems: Ask for your password, API key or 2FA code
Ask for your seed phrase or wallet
Offer to trade for you or double your money
Ask you to send funds anywhere
doItems: Report it in your help thread
Turn off DMs from server members
scams.foot: Not sure? Ask in help-desk. Real moderators only help you here, in the server.
